text: Daily cases now revisit topics you missed

sourcePayload.title: Daily cases now revisit topics you missed
sourcePayload.summary: Completed case-study answers on this browser can guide the next reviewed Daily case toward a topic you missed. New learners keep the regular rotation; approved questions, saved answers and streaks remain unchanged.

pass1.reason: The historical headline is the exact approved learning release. Its notice leads to What’s New and the release content links to Daily Practice.

pass2.reviewer: Codex assistant, separate source and existing verifier review
pass2.reason: The case selection only uses recent completed browser history, reviewed bank content, and a category gap. The fallback serves the regular rotation. The existing verifier passes, matching the full qualified release summary.
